description: This file defines the 'Node' class, a data structure used to store hierarchical configuration data with support for properties of various types, including methods for property access, modification, and hierarchical node management.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A class representing a hierarchical storage node with configurable properties, supporting type conversions and nested child nodes.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Default constructor needed for serialization, initializes an empty node.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Parameterized constructor that either loads existing node data from a parent map or creates a new node with a prefix.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Static method to check if a string can be parsed as a numeric value.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a child node with the specified name, creating it if nonexistent.

methods.name: getIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves an integer property value associated with the given key, returning a default if parsing fails.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property associated with the key, defaulting to false.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property with a specified default value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a string value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with an integer value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a boolean value.

methods.name: setBoolProperty
methods.description: Sets a boolean property.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property value with a default if not found.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property value, defaults to empty string if not found.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix identifier of the node (used by serializer).

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix identifier of the node (used by serializer).

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the internal configuration map of properties.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Replaces the internal configuration map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the node, primarily displaying its prefix.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a double value.

methods.name: getDoubleProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a double property value, defaulting if the value isn't numeric.
